style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern school corridor illustrating a false accusation repeated by many. Four students whisper and point toward an innocent child with an empty watering can beside a fallen potted plant. Each whisperer has a small identical pictorial speech bubble showing the child pushing over the plant, NO words. A listening student gradually looks convinced and joins the pointing, while the accused child looks distressed with open empty palms. A separate clearly bordered small TRUTH inset at upper left shows an earlier gust of wind blowing the plant off an open window ledge while the child was elsewhere carrying water. Main scene must distinguish real fallen plant, identical FALSE speech-bubble images, and earlier true cause. Emphasize multiple repeated falsehoods becoming accepted, not a single insult. Child-friendly no bullying glorified or injury. Natural hands and objects, stable perspective, no readable text letters numerals brands watermarks. Landscape 3:2 pencil watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper.
alt: 幾名學生反覆傳說同學推倒花盆，聽的人也開始指責，受冤的孩子攤手難過；角落小景顯示花盆其實被風吹落。
